title: Ripple Effect Canonical Representation
description: Rectangular grid pre-divided into rooms (polyominoes) by thick borders. Some cells carry positive integer clues. Players fill every cell so each room of size N contains 1..N, and equal values K in a row/column are at least K+1 cells apart.

cells.description: rows x cols grid of integers. 0 = empty cell, positive integer = a pre-filled clue in that cell.

edges.description: Thick room borders defining the partition. Board perimeter is an implicit border.

h.description: (rows-1) x cols array: h[r][c] = thick border between cell[r][c] and cell[r+1][c]. 0 = same room, 1 = room boundary.

v.description: rows x (cols-1) array: v[r][c] = thick border between cell[r][c] and cell[r][c+1]. 0 = same room, 1 = room boundary.
